                        Southwest Missouri Hay Auction - Golden City, MO
                        AMS Livestock, Poultry, & Grain Market News
                        Missouri Department of Agriculture

  Email us with accessibility issues with this report                                    Mon Oct 5, 2026


  Hay Auction Weighted Average Report for 10/5/2026 - Final
  Special Note:Auctions are held the first Saturday of every month at 10:00 am sharp. All hay is sold by the bale and average
  weights are provided for each lot. Test results are provided when available!
  A large crowd turned out for the monthly SW MO Hay Auction with demand being very good from buyers on site and online and
  absentee bids made for a successful auction. Dry conditions for the local area had some buyers stocking up for the colder
  months ahead. The round bales were 47 % of the offering and the large and small square bales were 53 %.
  Most of the Mixed grass round bales were selling with a higher trend this month and the other types selling mostly higher as
  well. Tonnage prices on other Hay: Alfalfa Premium 509.00/ton, Alfalfa Good/Premium- 295.00 to 393.00/ton; Alfalfa/Grass-
  Good 178.00 to 184.00/ton, Alfalfa/Grass Good to Premium- 224.00 to 376.00/ton; Alfalfa/Orchard Good 257.00/ton; Premium
  457.00 to 522.00.00/ton; Orchard/Brome Lg squares 262.00 to 346.00.00/ton. Teff 168.00 to 273.00/ton; Prairie hay round
  bales Good 96.00 to 116.00/ton. Prairie Lg Sq 103.00 to 133.00/ton. Mixed grasses Fair to Good 75.00 to 89.00/ton, and Good
  91.00 to 113.00/ton. Fescue/Fescue Mix- Good 88.00 to 116.00/ton

Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and quality of hay offered for sale. There may be
instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in the report. Prices are
reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.
